subject.title: feat(bedrock): enable prompt caching for Nova models

question: Should Nova prompt-cache eligibility use a generic provider capability, or may core permanently carry a Bedrock-specific Nova model classifier?
rationale: Repository architecture places vendor model policy in the owning plugin, while the shared agent resolver needs a generic way to preserve configuration before transport wrapping.

options.title: Use a provider capability
options.body: Add or reuse a generic cache-eligibility capability populated by the Bedrock plugin, remove the Nova ID list from core, and require live AWS proof before merge.

options.title: Accept duplicated matching
options.body: Keep the core and plugin classifiers synchronized intentionally, document the ownership exception, and still require live AWS proof.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open until a sponsored capability design and Nova-enabled proof environment are available.

recommendation.title: Use a provider capability
recommendation.body: Add or reuse a generic cache-eligibility capability populated by the Bedrock plugin, remove the Nova ID list from core, and require live AWS proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their application-profile caching work owns the closest existing Bedrock capability and payload-resolution path.
